title: fix(console): Setup › Apps delete names the package whose row it removes (objectui#12397)
body:
Fixes #12397
Clause-②: no

## What this does

Setup › Apps' `handleDelete` (`apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx`) now deletes through a new `deleteApp` helper. It mirrors the page's `saveApp`:

- When `owningPackage(app)` names a package, it calls `meta.deleteItem('app', name, { packageId })`. The SDK sends that as `?package=`.
- When there is no package, it calls `meta.deleteItem('app', name)`: no options bag, so the parameter is omitted and never sent empty. This covers an absent `_packageId`, an empty one, and the `sys_metadata` sentinel.

The scope comes only from the served `_packageId`. The page never guesses a package. A refusal still reaches the user through the existing `catch` and `reason(e)` path, as `Failed to delete app: ` followed by the server's sentence. No exported `@object-ui/*` symbol, prop or accept set changes: the edit is a module-private function in a page file. That is why `Clause-②: no` stands as measured.

The upstream half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23165: a package-less delete of a name two packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and names `?package=` as the remedy. The SDK half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23293.

## The installed client declares and sends it

objectui resolves `@objectstack/client` `18.0.0-next.1` (`node_modules/.pnpm/@objectstack+client@18.0.0-next.1_.../dist`). Its `index.d.ts` declares the method and the member:

```ts
deleteItem: (type: string, name: string, options?: DeleteMetaItemOptions) => Promise...   // type argument DeleteMetaItemResponse, elided here
```

```ts
interface DeleteMetaItemOptions {
    ...
    packageId?: string;
}
```

Its `index.js` sends the member (`metaDeleteQuery`):

```js
if (options.packageId) params.set("package", options.packageId);
```

## The card's Acceptance, quoted

> - `handleDelete` passes `{ packageId }` from `owningPackage(app)` when the app has one, and passes no package otherwise (omitted, never empty).
> - Pins: a package-owned app's delete names its package; a package-less app's delete names none; a 409 still reaches the user.
> - The two `MetadataService` callers: pass a binding where they hold one, or say why they do not.

## The two `MetadataService` callers: left package-less, and why

`packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts` is not edited.

| Caller | Holds a binding? | Call chain, measured at `dbc8c1169` |
|---|---|---|
| `MetadataService.deleteMetadataItem(category, name)` | No. Its parameters are a category and a name. No item, `_packageId` or package option is in hand at that point. | Its only non-test reference is its own declaration. |
| `MetadataService.deleteObject(objectName)` | No. Its only parameter is a name. | Its only non-test reference is its own declaration. |

Measured with `git grep -n 'deleteObject\b\|deleteMetadataItem' -- ':!*.test.*' ':!*.md'`. The only hits are the two declarations, one comment in the same file, and one comment in `scripts/check-designer-field-key-parity.mjs`.

The class is constructed only in `useMetadataService` (`new MetadataService(adapter)`). That hook is exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s barrel, and no in-repo source calls it. No in-repo caller holds a binding to pass. Giving either method a package option would add surface to a published class for a call that nothing in this repo makes, so they keep the package-less call. A 409 from either call rejects the returned promise, because neither method catches. The refusal reaches whoever calls the method; it is not swallowed.

## Tests

Pins were added to the existing `AppManagementPage.honestWrites-12300.test.tsx` harness, as a new `describe` named `Delete names the package whose row it removes (objectui#12397)`. The fake door now models objectstack#23165: a delete that names no package of a name two packages hold throws `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409, worded as `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal` words it.

- A package-owned app (held by two packages) is deleted with `['app', 'lanebapp_app', { packageId: 'com.qa.lanebapp' }]`. It is not refused, the toast is `deleted`, and the named package's row goes.
- A code-package app's delete names its package too.
- A package-less app's delete is `['app', 'ops_app']`, with no options bag.
- An app served with the `sys_metadata` sentinel is deleted with `['app', 'local_app']`.
- A 409 still reaches the user. A package-less app whose name two packages hold is refused, and the page shows an error toast starting `Failed to delete app: ` that carries the server's `?package=` remedy. No success or info toast appears, and the row stays after the re-read.

Runs, all from the repo root at `03c15a90e`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/__tests__/AppManagementPage.honestWrites-12300.test.tsx`: `Tests 16 passed (16)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/system/ packages/app-shell/src/services/`: `Test Files 36 passed (36)`, `Tests 304 passed (304)`.
- NOT MEASURED: the full app-shell project, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/`. It held the shared lock for about 30 minutes without finishing and printed no result. I stopped my own run by PID. app-shell has no change in this diff, and its `services/` directory (which holds the `MetadataService` suites) is in the 36-file run above. The full project is declared to CI.

**Ablation** (one-time; no permanent file). The page imports the module from source, so no build sits in the path. I ran `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack checkout) on the committed tree. It replaced the anchor `? meta.deleteItem('app', app.name, { packageId })` with `? meta.deleteItem('app', app.name)`:

- Mutation: the anchor count went from 1 to 0, and the blob went from `e80e632bd0f6` to `59bcd377c993`.
- Result: `Tests 2 failed | 14 passed (16)`. The two packaged-delete cases failed. The package-less, sentinel and 409 cases stayed green, as they must.
- Restore: the blob after restore equals HEAD (`e80e632bd0f6`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates

- Closure build: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build` exited 0.
- Type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exited 0.
- Lint, narrowed to the changed files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the two changed `.tsx` files. The checked population is those 2 files, and the JSON output counts 2 file results. The run shows 0 errors and 9 `no-explicit-any` warnings, all on pre-existing lines. `origin/main`'s copy of the page gives the same 9 when run through `--stdin`. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off. The diff therefore cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- The pre-tsc battery exited 0 for each of these: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity` and `control-bytes`.
- `check:spec-floors` exited 1, as it already does on `main` (objectui#12334). It was recorded, not fixed.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` exited 0, and so did `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12397-app-delete-package.md` declares `'@object-ui/console': patch`. `@object-ui/console` is in the `fixed` group and is not `private`, and its `src/` changed. `@object-ui/app-shell` is not edited, so it is not listed.

## Acceptance notes

- `MetadataService.putMetadataItem` saves with `client.meta.saveItem(category, name, data)` and names no package either. It has the same shape as the two deletes and the same zero in-repo callers (the class is reached only through the uncalled `useMetadataService`), so it is dormant here. It is noted only; nobody owns it.
- NOT MEASURED: a live 409 against a booted `18.0.0-next.1` server. The pins use the harness's model of the door.
